fact: PCH's Internet Exchange Directory lists CV-IXP (Associação Cabo Verde Internet Exchange Point) in Praia as an Active Ethernet exchange established 29 November 2022; the record lists no switches, facilities or participants, and the page has no date of its own so the established date is used.

PeeringDB lists CV-IXP in Praia with 5 peers (Banco Caboverdiano de Negocios, CV Telecom, NOSi EPE, UNITEL T and the CV-IXP route servers), 6 connections and 23G total capacity; the document is dated 2024 only to the year.

The Cabo Verde government's own status booklet states that it has introduced the IXP (Internet Exchange Point), with the effect of lowering costs and latency and improving internet quality; no exchange name, city or member count is given and no event date is given, so as_of is the document's published date (2026-04).
